summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K announcing final results of a voluntary share exchange offer by Cadeler plc to Cadeler shareholders, part of a Danish-to-UK redomiciliation (the US equivalent is a holdco reorganization via stock-for-stock exchange). Terms: one Cadeler plc share per Cadeler share, including ADSs (four shares each). Acceptance reached 92.06% (355,404,839 shares, 11,156,931 via ADSs), satisfying the 90% minimum condition; offer expired 28 October 2026, settlement expected on or around 4 November 2026, with NYSE and Oslo listing on or around 5 November 2026. Cadeler plc has begun compulsory cash squeeze-out of the remaining 7.94% under the Danish Companies Act, publishing a four-week transfer notice. Watch regulatory/listing mechanics and squeeze-out timing.
